steps.title: Start with a panel and a piece
steps.instruction: Join a panel and a piece (A, B), as the animation shows. Page 3 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: A panel and a piece are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the NILS chair. Page 3 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (panel, about 82 cm), B (piece, about 42 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 82 cm tall.
